repos.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.eli5: It’s like a notebook that writes down everything a smart robot does, shrinks the notes so they fit, and then shows the robot the important bits next time it talks to you.

repos.name: vercel-labs/agent-desktop
repos.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents
repos.eli5: It lets a computer‑brain see and click on the buttons of any program, just like you would with a mouse, but using a list of the program’s parts instead of pictures.

repos.name: max-sixty/worktrunk
repos.description: Worktrunk is a CLI for Git worktree management, designed for parallel AI agent workflows
repos.eli5: It’s a toolbox that helps you keep many copies of a project organized side‑by‑side, so several robot helpers can work on different parts without stepping on each other’s toes.

repos.name: JustVugg/colibri
repos.description: A hierarchical inference engine for frontier MoE models: hot experts on the GPU (CUDA, Vulkan), warm ones in RAM, cold ones streamed from NVMe. Written in C, runs on the hardware you already own.
repos.eli5: Imagine a huge library where only the books you need right now are taken off the shelf, while the rest stay in storage; this lets big AI models run on your own computer without needing a super‑computer.

repos.name: mattpocock/skills
repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.eli5: It’s a collection of little cheat‑sheets that teach AI helpers how to do real‑world engineering tasks, like a toolbox of ready‑made tricks anyone can copy.

repos.name: p-e-w/heretic
repos.description: Training-free language model modification: Remove censorship, suppress slop, reduce sycophancy, and more
repos.eli5: It’s a magic wand that can change the behavior of a language model on the fly, like removing a filter or making it less shy, without having to retrain it.

repos.name: spotify/portal-ai-plugins
repos.eli5: It adds a set of shortcuts so an AI assistant can talk to Spotify’s internal tools, like a remote control that lets the robot turn on lights, check status, and run jobs.

repos.name: floci-io/floci
repos.description: Light, fluffy, and always free - The AWS Local Emulator alternative
repos.eli5: It’s a pretend version of Amazon’s cloud services that runs on your laptop, so you can test cloud apps without paying or connecting to the real internet cloud.

repos.name: Usagi-org/ai-goofish-monitor
repos.description: 基于 Playwright 和AI实现的闲鱼多任务实时/定时监控与智能分析系统，配备了功能完善的后台管理UI。帮助用户从闲鱼海量商品中，找到心仪产品。
repos.eli5: It’s like a robot shopper that watches a website for new items you want, using AI to decide if they’re good, and tells you when they appear.

repos.name: anomalyco/hex
repos.description: Local voice dictation for mac, windows and linux
repos.eli5: It lets you talk to your computer and have what you say typed wherever you’re working, like a secret whisper that turns into text on the screen.
